_comment: Synthetic Alpha 2 qualification cases (#57). {{Sn}} is the n-th synthetic secret, {{ESn}} its \u-escaped form, {{PEM}} a synthetic revoked-looking private key, {{WARN}} a synthetic Warn-class text. Shared by the Node and Python harnesses.

cases.note: content before tool_calls: its secret is numbered first
messages, tools, stop, user, metadata, response_format: the documented traversal order
on_warn=forward: the Warn text is kept, the Redact secret is still replaced
documented gap: the common profile has no GitHub token detector, so the synthetic token is forwarded unchanged
documented gap: the pinned core has no Korean national-ID or phone detector (invented numbers); forwarded unchanged
replaying a provider message verbatim (refusal: null) is rejected as an unknown field
